pickFieldHint: Pick a field to see its vegetation intelligence.
title: Satellite Intelligence
description: Vegetation indices from satellite scenes, screened against same-month seasonal baselines. Observed change is reported as statistics — never a disease or yield claim on its own.
noData: No satellite observations yet for this field.
ingestHint: Ingest via the Observations tab (provider: Sentinel-2 live or the synthetic fixture for demos).
noFindings: No anomalies or trends against the seasonal baselines.
syntheticBadge: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE — never real satellite data
causeUnknown: No corroborating environmental evidence — cause unknown
layersDesc: Backend-rendered previews of derived index products, clipped to the field's documented WGS84 footprint and drawn over the farm map.
indexDescEVI: Enhanced vegetation vigor, less soil and atmospheric saturation
unavailableHint: No derived products for {codes} yet — process scenes in the scene catalog to enable them.
noProductsDesc: Acquired scenes must be processed (NDVI/EVI/NDMI/NDWI/BSI derivation) before they can be drawn as map layers. Open the scene catalog to acquire and process scenes for this field.
layersLoadError: Could not load the satellite processing ledger.
previewError: Preview rendering could not be loaded.
noPreviewHint: No preview rendering available for this product.
processQueued: {count, plural, one {Derivation queued for # scene} other {Derivation queued for # scenes}}
processSkipped: {count, plural, one {# scene skipped (already processed)} other {# scenes skipped (already processed)}}
profileDesc: Evidence-bounded temporal analysis of the selected index: observations, baseline comparison, coverage gaps and statistical zones — never a diagnosis on its own.
profileLoadError: Could not load the field satellite profile.
freshnessFresh: {days, plural, one {# day ago · fresh} other {# days ago · fresh}}
freshnessStale: {days, plural, one {# day ago · stale} other {# days ago · stale}}
weakEvidenceNote: Weak evidence — single-scene comparison against a wide baseline spread; reported as a statistic, not interpreted.
